title: Natural Cech cup and its scalar-model homology comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For every $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, use the concrete functors $T(F)$ and $P(F)$ of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-cech-exact]: tensor total of the two finite-cover scalar Cech complexes extended by zero, and scalar Cech complex on the product cover of the external coefficient extended by zero, respectively. There exists a natural transformation $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ on all left coefficient modules. For every quasi-coherent $F$, every cochain map $d:\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(f,g,F,G)\to\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ satisfying the normalization predicate of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain], and every natural $n$, there exist isomorphisms $a:H^n(T(F))\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(f,g,F,G))$ and $b:H^n(P(F))\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G))$ with $H^n(\theta_F);b=a;H^n(d)$. The scalar models and their canonical homology identifications are those of [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. There is no short exact sequence or connecting homomorphism in this assertion.

proof.text: Obtain the natural transformation theta, the generator-coordinate equivalence e into tensor Cech homology and the product comparison b from the geometric Cech generator statement. No scalar-total cochain realization is chosen in this step.

For the two scalar models apply tensor_kunneth_nat with their proved negative-term vanishing, obtaining s from the same direct sum to scalar tensor-total homology. Define the required tensor comparison a as e inverse followed by s.

For every direct-sum summand and pure tensor x tensor y, lift x and y through the epimorphic scalar-model homology projections. Tensor Kunneth supplies a total cycle z and its homology formula. The generator formula for theta and normalization of the given d have the identical externalCup value; cancel the injective product scalarModelEquiv. DirectSum.linearMap_ext and TensorProduct.ext' extend the equality to the whole direct sum. Evaluate at e inverse of an arbitrary tensor-Cech homology class to get H(theta) followed by b equals a followed by H(d).
